title: Understanding the Logistic Regression Model
text: The logistic regression model is used to predict the probability of a binary outcome. In this case, it predicts whether a reply was made by an Ed bot. The formula is $$P(y=1|x)=\operatorname{\sigma}\left(\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2\right)$$, where σ is the sigmoid function.

title: Calculating the Linear Combination
text: To find the linear combination, use the given values: $$likes=3$$ and $$response_{time}=34$$. Substitute these into the equation $$\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2$$ with $$\theta_1=1$$ and $$\theta_2=2$$.

title: Understanding Odds
text: Odds are calculated as the exponential of the linear combination. In this case, the odds of being a bot are $$e^{\theta_1 x_1+\theta_2 x_2}$$.

title: Calculate the Odds for a Bot
text: What are the odds that the reply was made by a bot, given the linear combination you calculated?

title: Odds for a Human
text: To find the odds that a reply was made by a human, take the reciprocal of the odds for a bot.
